title: Degree support of the homogeneous quotient action
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of schemes, $L$ invertible, and $T$ a TensorGradedPresentation [lem-sc-square-zero-tensor-graded-presentation]. Let $a,d\in\mathbb N$ and $s\in\Gamma(X,j_*j^*(L^a))$. Suppose local ring actions $\sigma_U$ and a global endomorphism action $\mu$ satisfy $i(\sigma_U(p(b))y)=b i(y)$ and $(\mu(g))_U(y)=\sigma_U(g|_U)y$. Then there is a morphism $v:K_d\to K_{d+a}$ such that $k_d;\mu(c_a(s))=v;k_{d+a}$, where $K_r=\ker(L^r\to j_*j^*L^r)$. There are no canonical tensor comparisons or output projections in this statement.

source.place: Tag 09MS, coherent-equation-ses and its graded direct sum; Tag 0B8S, cohomology-lemma-boundary-derivation-over-cup-product, first proof paragraph.

proof.text: The unit in degree a is epi by the closed-immersion unit quotient. Compare the two chosen adjunction units using leftAdjointUniq to transfer Epi, then use Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi and TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff to obtain local lifts t of s.

Compute the local acted-on inclusion with hglobal, hlocal, b_quotient, k_inclusion and b_multiply. Write the result b_(a+d)(z). Applying p and hw gives c_(a+d)(unit(z))=0. Since c_projection makes c_(a+d) mono, unit(z)=0. Mathlib evaluation preserves kernels; range_map_kernelι gives a section z′ with inclusion z. Cancel the mono i to identify the acted-on section with k_(a+d)(z′).

Define v=k_d;mu(c_a(s));degree_(d+a).tau1. On each local lifting open, k_projection gives v(y)=z′. Use naturality of the two global morphisms and TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq′ to glue the factorization. The calculation includes degree zero and empty opens.
